SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.Player) AS player_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM main.Player) AS distinct_player_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.home_player_3) AS slot_players,
    COUNT(p.id) AS matched_appearances,
    COUNT(m.home_player_3) AS recorded_appearances,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND m.home_team_goal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_scores,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN m.home_team_goal END) AS qualifying_goals
FROM main."Match" AS m
LEFT JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3;

WITH player_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(m.home_team_goal), 0) AS total_home_goals
    FROM main.Player AS p
    LEFT JOIN main."Match" AS m ON m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
    GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_totals
LIMIT 1
